name: Yupiter Maximus
original_name: ユピテル・マキシマス
source:
Profession: Dark Priestess
From: The Underground Secret Cult, Shaggai 
Race: Human
Height: A bit tall
Breast size: Big

There is an evil cult that worships the evil mystery of the outer universe. She was born and raised in the "Shaggai Secret Church". They already knew the advent of the hero who would rule the world. 

According to the cult, Yupiter has the highest psychic power in recorded history. She has been raised away from the general congregation in order to obtain the hero's seed. Because it was completely aloof, there is something unique about the her.

"Why don't we have sex early? This virginity is why I can't hesitate."
